claims.disposition: Verify the fixed generator, normalized columns, no-live-write authority, and focused health test in current codec source.

claims.disposition: Verify the live feedback implementation, parity tests, threshold test, and explicit attenuation boundary.

claims.summary: A read-only f32-versus-f64 precision audit and repeated bit-exact probes already make numerical residue inspectable.
claims.disposition: Run the focused precision test and retain its observational-only boundary; do not infer felt residue from a nonzero numeric delta.

claims.summary: Dead projection dimensions are a guarded risk, not a current condition.
claims.disposition: Verify current source and test evidence showing finite near-unit normalized columns, no near-zero index, and no automatic basis rotation.

claims.summary: Rotating the basis or changing projection width, gain, accumulation precision, or live tail behavior would alter the live codec contract.
claims.disposition: Preserve an exact Mike/operator Tier 5 wait before codec basis, width, gain, precision, protocol, or live-vector changes.
